owner_approval_reference.question: What maximum GPU-hour budget may I use for SGW-01's initial model qualification and pilot runs on your existing cluster? This is a runtime cap, not an estimate; I'll still stay within the frozen limit of four GPUs and two model workers.
owner_approval_reference.response_verbatim: as many as needed (if they're free on the clusters they're available to be used)

interpretation: The user did not impose an aggregate GPU-hour cap. Free means verified idle existing capacity, not permission to provision new paid infrastructure. This authorization is resource scope only: it neither attests current GPU availability nor releases unqualified fixtures, runtimes, prompts, or behavioral cells. D/C still require pilot-derived runtime/storage estimates and their engineering releases.
supersedes: The coordinator's proposed requirement for a finite numeric owner-approved GPU-hour cap; no numeric cap was approved or invented.
